title: Reading Drill — Reassembling a model ship — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Reassembling a model ship — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The museum model maker in Hillswick received an old report about small loose pieces losing their original positions. The report compared parts assigned with confidence, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the assembly photographs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include earlier replacement parts. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed labelled trays during repair as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
